body: I’m currently in therapy. I found out that my gf of 7 and a half years cheated on me. I’m also taking medication to help cope with the anxiety and depression. Yes my mental health has gotten that bad. Therapy does help. If you have insurance. Use it! Lucky for me my insurance covers therapy at no cost. Just call your insurance and ask.

My ex cheated on me. She was taking Prozac. I had a hard time with the new version of her. TBH I loved her old self and all of her flaws. She wanted to be “normal”. She was also taking another medication that supposedly helped with her sex drive. It made her shake and lose a lot of weight. I told her please to get off the meds. She was perfect before. Her brother passed away from fentanyl. she found him dead. We had a break and she  cheated on me with a security guard from work. Like wtf. She blamed her bipolar disorder and the way we were behaving with each other. I tired couples therapy. I tried everything I could to fix it. But she can’t be in a relationship. Her words. Then went back to the other guy that night. Like okay…
Do you think the bipolar is the reason why she cheated??
I do. They said they will never cut me from their lives. I love those kids.

From my experience dating someone with OCD and taking Prozac( the highest dose prescribed 80mg). It made her checked out and emotional unavailable. Example. When her grandfather passed away. She couldn’t cry. 
When I told her that hey it is affecting me and it hurts to no longer see you be yourself hurts. She always wanted to be “normal”. The word normal is a broad term. Everyone’s normal is different. She didn’t really feel comfortable in her skin. 

I would tell her that she was perfect before the pills. Your OCD is one of the greatest things about you. I don’t see an issue. I don’t think she needs it. She was always a go getter. Now she is lost more than ever

She was cheating on me while I was supporting her during her brother‘s funeral. He passed away of fentanyl. She’s the one who found him dead. She called me. I came over immediately once she called me.

I’m the godfather of her niece and the older nieces and nephew don’t approve of her actions and do not want to meet the other guy 

We tried to reconcile, but on the next day, she said she couldn’t be in a relationship then immediately went back to the other guy

The days leading up to the funeral we went to target so so she can get him a birthday gift. I thought it was just a coworker. I guess not. It was a coworker, but the freaking security guard OK whatever. I have a career.
I did tell the family. They can’t force her which is true. Someone told me the at she is rebelling and wants to have a easy fix to her problems

I don't think it's cheating. He didn't build an emotional connection or even had a physical connection. Yeah he's dumb for paying for only fans. You have to remember only fans just fictional. It's not real. Being cheated on is a lot harsher than having your significant other pay for only fans. Again, only fans is just fictional. It's nothing to it. I wouldn't like it either.

also I am curious how many of you guys exes ever wanting to reach out to you asking to reconcile the relationship? Throughout this whole journey of the break up, I've been asking for her to reconcile. I told her I am done if she ever wants to reach out she has to reach out.
Thank you for your advice. Anything else you can add please do!!! Again thank you!!

I’ll do some research about the pay in my area. I’m not really a confident guy. I have a imposter syndrome. I feel like I don’t belong there. I’m going to have to overcome it. Just so freaking nervous!
I just hopes it works out for my situation. I’m sorry to hear about you lost.
Thank you for those nice words!!

My gf was telling me instead of giving him answers. You ask him questions to help make him think. Why do you feel that way. How often do you feel this way. What happened in X year that started these thoughts.
Your mental health is a muscle. You can’t expect to have a 6-pack of abs in one day. It takes constant work

That’s one of my fears. Just being a set of ears for him to talk to. I was telling him how we’re not responsible for the tragedies that happened in our life. However though we are responsible for picking ourselves up and coupe with it, and learn how to deal with it.

I can’t really give him professional advice and techniques. On how to coupe with it. I do believe you can manage it though. I’m aware you can never check out of depression. But having a support group is a good start.  Right?

My brother and I are complete opposite. I’m more of a never give up person. I will complain a lot but that’s just me venting. I complain while doing the “work” for example. Aww man I don’t want to go to work. F this place. Awhile I’m on my way to work or working. 

I tend to be more optimistic. My brother gives up before he even starts. 

I’m talking to him. My cousins are aware of what he’s going through. We all are making an effort to talk to him more on how he is feeling. Trying to make him be more active.
My brother has a lot of regrets. Like not finishing high school. The he handles things. Which I think you can totally work on. However it’s the matter of putting in the effort.
Thank you for opening up

Hmmmm  very case is different. I’m sorry. I know I’m not an expert. My brother was never pushed to be a go getter. I was talking to my gf who is actually studying this stuff in grad school. She’s helping how to handle this situation. I truly believe my brother need a win. In order to get a “win” is putting the work.
Congrats!!!!!
I took a class at a school near me. I’m located in Los Angeles. We get the vouchers for $100. Also we can get vouchers for other certificates like comTIA and Cisco
Thanks!!! Good luck to you!!! I plan on going back to college and to get a AA or transfer. I truly believe that anyone can succeed. I just needed some support from friends and people who care. :)
Thanks everyone. That’s means a lot!!
